# viettelcloud_lb_member (Data Source)

Read details of a Viettel Cloud Load Balancer Server Group Member.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up a server group member by ID
data "viettelcloud_lb_member" "by_id" {
  server_group_id = "11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111"
  id              = "22222222-2222-2222-2222-222222222222"
}

# Look up a server group member by name
data "viettelcloud_lb_member" "by_name" {
  server_group_id = "11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111"
  name            = "web-server-1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `server_group_id` (String) Server Group ID (UUID) that owns this member.

### Optional

- `id` (String) Server Group Member ID (UUID).
- `name` (String) Name of the Server Group Member.

### Read-Only

- `address` (String) IP address of the backend member.
- `backup` (Boolean) Whether the member is a backup member.
- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the Server Group Member was created (RFC3339).
- `protocol_port` (Number) Port on which the member listens for traffic.
- `provisioning_status` (String) Provisioning status of the Server Group Member.
- `status` (String) Operational status of the Server Group Member.
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp when the Server Group Member was last updated (RFC3339).
- `weight` (Number) Weight of the member in the server group.
